Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 map size is so big it rivals GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2's combined - and Rockstar devs are still discovering places they've never seen News By Anna Koselke Published 30 October 2026 "It's insane," fans say When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter GTA 6 isn't just gearing up to be one of the biggest game launches in history - it might just be one of the biggest games , period, with a map that's twice as big as its predecessor's. Rockstar tells Edge as much as part of its exclusive cover story , revealing that the total land mass - including both Vice City and its surrounding areas - is almost as big as the playable maps that GTA 4, 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 boast... combined. That's downright massive, to say the least, but it's made all the more impressive by the sheer amount of detail to it. The world is set to feel alive and immersive at every turn., Aaron Garbut, head of development and co-studio lead, confirms as much, stating that GTA 6 has "an order of magnitude more interiors" than older Grand Theft Auto entries, including the fifth. "Every back alley is as densely detailed and interesting as the others. You can go anywhere, any random location, and so many people have thought about that location." Heck, after years of exploring himself, Garbut states he's still discovering places he's never seen. Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Rockstar Games tells GamesRadar the GTAVI map is "is nearly as large as the playable maps of GTAIV, GTAV and RDR2 combined" from r/GTA6unmoderated Unsurprisingly, news of the game's mind-boggling size has reached online forums. Over on Reddit , folks are reacting to the prospect of such a large map in GTA 6, with some drawing comparisons to Red Dead Redemption 2 and how it "has a lot of locked doors for as sparsely populated with dwellings the game is" - an issue the new GTA apparently won't suffer from itself with all those "interiors" Garbut makes mention of. One commenter shares their disbelief at the size, writing, "I still can't scarcely believe this is running on PS5 and Xbox Series X. It's insane how big it is." It is quite a thought, admittedly, considering the behemoth is running on consoles that are now a solid six years old, but the GTA 6 extended look on Netflix showed it in action back in August. Plus, as somebody points out, "GTA 5 for the PS3 and Xbox 360 was a similar feat at the time." You may like The GTA 6 map is 3 times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's GTA 6 is so big, Rockstar doesn't "know that there's anybody on the team that knows all of it" GTA 6 is "a whole other world" where "there's a whole lot of stuff that you discover emergently" There's no telling how the community will find the huge map until GTA 6 finally releases next month - but regardless, it's undeniably one of the biggest new games underway. Nearly 1 in 3 gamers plan to buy GTA 6 in the US, analyst confirms: "A rare cultural and commercial moment." Do you work in videogames?
